headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs fell short in Pittsburgh, while the Tampa Bay Rays suffered a 7-9 loss to the Baltimore Orioles. The Minnesota Twins were defeated by the Chicago White Sox, and the St. Louis Cardinals lost to the Milwaukee Brewers. The Washington Nationals' Max Kranick has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to his ongoing right elbow surgery recovery.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players landing on the injured list. Washington Nationals right-handed pitcher Max Kranick has been transferred to the 60-day injured list. The Toronto Blue Jays placed right-handed pitcher Dylan Cease on the 15-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The Colorado Rockies placed left-handed pitcher Jose Quintana on the 10-day injured list with a left elbow sprain. Other notable injuries include left-handed pitcher Erik Sabrowski of the Cleveland Guardians, right-handed pitcher Cole Winn of the Texas Rangers, right-handed pitcher Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals, right-handed pitcher Edward Cabrera of the Chicago Cubs, and right-handed fielder Jonny DeLuca of the Tampa Bay Rays.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Colorado Rockies trading left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds. The Tampa Bay Rays traded left-handed pitcher Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for third baseman Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 1-2 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates, unable to overcome a strong Pirates performance. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in 7-9 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged the Tampa Bay Rays 7-9 in a closely contested matchup. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 1-3 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Romo leading the Twins' offense.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals' Max Kranick Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right-handed pitcher Max Kranick has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to his ongoing right elbow surgery recovery.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
